core_categories: Pharmaceutical Dispensing; Medication Packaging; Clinical Consulting; Health Recovery Products
specialty_focus: MediSystem Pharmacy is a specialized Canadian institutional pharmacy serving long-term care homes, retirement residences, and assisted living facilities. It focuses on pharmaceutical dispensing, advanced medication packaging (blister packs), and clinical consulting, with 24/7 support. It does not specifically deal in wearable medical devices.
